summary: v10.2.21 BCH SHORT anti-loss trio validated (25/25 PASS). Covered: (1) Anti-chase SELL blocks non-BTC alt SELL when 1h snapshot shows last 6h drop >= 3% with reject prefix 'anti_chase_sell_<pct>pct_<h>h'; -2% does NOT block (continues to confirm gate). (2) SELL confirmation 2 cycles via _buy_confirm_eval(required_cycles=SELL_CONFIRM_CYCLES=2): cycle-1 rejects 'sell_menunggu_konfirmasi_siklus_2' + no execute_trade, cycle-2 identical fires execute_trade, count resets to 0 + consumed_at set after exec. (3) BUY regressions preserved: 2-cycle confirmation, anti-flap trending_up (streak<3), bear4h conf+5 bonus. (4) Engine stale-exit for longterm/Confluence v9 trades (age>3h, max_floating_pct<0.5%, |floating|<0.5%): close_position called + close_reason='stale_exit' + stale_exit_at='longterm_stale_<age>h_max<pct>pct'. max_floating_pct persisted when higher. Negative controls (age<3h, prev max>=0.5%, current pct>0.5%, scalper, day) do NOT close. Horizon-exit-first-tick prevents double close_position (swing+hit_and_run+aged>24h triggers horizon_exit, stale-exit guard skips). (5) GET /api/asi/scan-debug?device_id=hc returns buy_gates with all 6 fields and correct values (buy_confirm_cycles=2, sell_confirm_cycles=2, sell_chase_pct=3.0, sell_chase_window_h=6, longterm_stale_hours=3.0, longterm_stale_min_profit_pct=0.5). (6) iter49 lossless-fill regression (TP attribution via /fapi/v1/userTrades + idempotency) still 12 PASS. All br.*, engine.close_position, engine.move_sl_to_breakeven, engine.decrypt, market_data.get_crypto_snapshot, scheduler.execute_trade & resolve_credential monkeypatched — no real exchange calls.

rca_of_issue: User reported BCH SHORT entering near local bottom + grinding against SL for 6+ hours (classic BCH 16/10 case). Fix is a 3-layer defence at scheduler level (no signal-formula change): (1) ANTI-CHASE SELL — if alt already down >=3% in last 6h, reject SELL to avoid shorting at the capitulation low where mean-reversion bounce probability spikes. (2) SELL CONFIRMATION 2 CYCLES — require identical SELL signal in two consecutive scanner cycles (~90s apart) to filter out one-shot flap-prone signals; symmetric with the BUY confirmation added in v10.2.17. (3) EARLY-EXIT STALE LONGTERM — for Confluence v9 / longterm / swing trades older than 3h that never reached +0.5% floating profit, close at market instead of waiting for full SL hit (saves 50-70% of SL loss size on grind-against trades). Engine persists max_floating_pct per refresh tick to track the historical high; horizon_exit always wins if both would fire in same tick. All constants exposed via GET /api/asi/scan-debug.buy_gates for in-app monitoring. No live exchange orders placed during testing — mocks for br.*, close_position, execute_trade, snapshot, credential.
